sections.heading: LIBRARY SECTION
sections.content:
Prof. TANAJI S. MALI Librarian ContactNo:- 9960424904 E-Mail ID: apcoerlibrary@gmail.com library@abmspcoerpune.org
APCOER is having total 621.34 sqm specious area for Library. In the library we have different sections like book stacking, periodicals, reference, digital library with 14 nodes & well ventilated reading hall with capacity of 160 students.  NPTEL video Lectures delivered by India’s best teachers are also available in library. The open access provided to all members. All the books have been classified as per Dewey decimal classification system. Transaction of books has been done by computerized barcode system through VRIDDHI software. OPAC Search facility available in Library Premises. Library timing is 9.00 am to 6.00 pm & reading hall timing will be adjusted to cater the needs of all the students.
Monday to Saturday: 9.00 AM to 6.00 PM
During Examination Period Only: 9.00 AM to 7.00 PM
Circulation section: – Stacks books which can be issued to the students and staff.
Reference Section: – Has a collection of Encyclopedias, dictionaries, handbooks, manuals and Reference books.
Reading Hall: – Spacious and well lit reading hall.
Periodical Section: – It displays the latest volumes of International and National journals and Magazines.
Reprography Section: -Two photocopying machines will be made available in the library to cater the photocopying needs of the library users.
Digital Library:- Library having 10 nodes for access E-Journals, E-Content, NPTEL videos with multimedia facility.
